sources.verified_angle_summary: The Saudi Ministry of Tourism has launched a new unified digital platform for tourism services during the LEAP 2026 technology conference in Riyadh. The platform is designed to be the primary digital destination for investors, tourism activity practitioners, and sector workers. It consolidates access to various services including tourism licensing, compliance, investment, training, and development. A key feature of the platform is the integration of "Tourism X," an AI-powered service that facilitates access to services and answers beneficiary inquiries, thereby enhancing the digital user experience. Ministry spokesperson Nasr Al-Ansari confirmed the launch aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals. Additionally, the Ministry signed an MoU with Accenture to collaborate on adopting AI and digital transformation within the tourism ecosystem. This announcement provides a concrete, non-duplicated government launch at LEAP 2026, suitable for a detailed TechScoop article on public sector digital transformation.
